summary.text: Ray Pooley, a CNC machinist and programmer, was the Democratic nominee for the U.S. House in Michigan's 9th District and lost the November 3, 2026 election to Lisa McClain.
He describes himself as a third-generation manufacturer.

paragraphs.text: Ray Pooley graduated from Hartland High School and works as a CNC machinist and programmer.
In his Ballotpedia survey he describes himself as a third-generation manufacturer with 15 years of personal experience in the industry.
Pooley advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary for Michigan's 9th District; it was his first run for Congress.
During the campaign, his website listed manufacturing jobs, family farms and tax fairness among its priorities.
Pooley received 34.7% of the vote to Lisa McClain's 62.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
